Name: Amnon
Summary: Amnon, David's firstborn by Ahinoam, lusted after his half-sister Tamar, tricked her into his chamber, and assaulted her, then hated her and cast her out. Two years later Absalom had him murdered at a sheep-shearing feast.
KeyStory: Amnon's lust for Tamar destroyed his sister, his standing, and finally his life.
RelatedPeople: King David; Ahinoam the Jezreelitess; Tamar, Daughter of David; Absalom
LifeLesson: Lust that takes what it wants and then hates what it took destroys everyone it touches.
